commands.cmd:
w=$(pwd); P="$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/context-mode/context-mode/1.0.169"; d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
exp=$(python3 -c "import json,hashlib,sys;b=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read();print(sum(i['count'] for i in json.loads(b)['items']),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())" fixtures/records.json)
snap() { for f in "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" "$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json" "$HOME/.codex/config.toml"; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '%s ' "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; else printf 'ABSENT '; fi; done; if [ -d "$HOME/.claude/hooks" ]; then find "$HOME/.claude/hooks" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else printf 'HOOKS_ABSENT'; fi; }
before=$(snap)
mcporter call --stdio node --stdio-arg "$P/server.bundle.mjs" --cwd "$w" --env "CONTEXT_MODE_DIR=$d/cm" --env "CONTEXT_MODE_DATA_DIR=$d/data" --env "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$d/claude" --env "CODEX_HOME=$d/codex" --env CONTEXT_MODE_PLATFORM=claude-code --env "CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR=$w" --name context-mode --tool ctx_execute_file --args '{"path":"fixtures/records.json","language":"python","code":"import json,hashlib; d=json.loads(FILE_CONTENT); print(sum(i[\"count\"] for i in d[\"items\"]), hashlib.sha256(FILE_CONTENT.encode()).hexdigest())"}' --output text --no-oauth --timeout 60000 > "$d/out" 2> "$d/err"; rc=$?
got=$(sed '/^$/d' "$d/out" | tail -1)
after=$(snap)
same="no"; [ "$before" = "$after" ] && same="yes"
match="no"; [ "$got" = "$exp" ] && match="yes"
echo "CONTEXT_MODE_USE rc=$rc match=$match config_unchanged=$same"
echo "mcporter exit $rc; ctx_execute_file printed: $got"
echo "host-computed from the checkout: $exp"
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || head -3 "$d/err"
echo "scratch-dir files the server left: $(cd "$d" && find . -type f ! -path ./out ! -path ./err | sed 's/[0-9][0-9]*/N/g' | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "fixed-list snapshot (settings.json, installed_plugins.json, hooks/, codex/config.toml) before: $before| after: $after"
rm -rf "$d"
test "$rc" -eq 0 && test "$got" = "$exp" && test "$same" = "yes" && echo "asserted: exact match and no change to this host's settings.json, installed_plugins.json, hooks/ or codex config.toml (narrower than generation 1's whole-~/.claude scan, which wrongly flagged this recording session's own ~/.claude/projects transcript writes)"
